entries.note: Slabs per the 56th GST Council recommendations (PIB, 03 SEP 2025): 18% standard, 5% merit, 40% de-merit, plus Nil for listed items. Effective 22 Sep 2025 for services and for all goods except pan masala, gutkha, cigarettes, chewing tobacco, unmanufactured tobacco and bidi. The GST Council Dec-2025 newsletter says those moved to the revised structure (40%; biris in the 18% band, CGST Schedule II 9%) from 1 Feb 2026, and compensation cess on them became Nil. Split: intra-State = CGST + SGST/UTGST; inter-State = IGST (= CGST + SGST). The fetched sources do not state the "each half" rule in words; the 9% CGST Schedule II rate (half of 18%) is the only explicit evidence. Other special rates (e.g. 3% precious metals, 0.25%) are not recorded because no fetched current source states them. The rate notification 9/2025-Central Tax (Rate) itself was not fetched.

rates.sourceQuote: Rationalisation of the current 4-tiered tax rate structure into a citizenfriendly `Simple Tax' - a 2 rate structure with a Standard Rate of 18% and a Merit Rate of 5%; a special de-merit rate of 40% for a select few goods and services
